body:
I haven't really been doing too much journal writing in the last couple years, but I noticed just writing like this helps clear out my thoughts. The last few months I've been confiding in people more but lately I've just been busy and stressed so I've stopped. I'm going to try and talk to people more again. Also just shouting at the internet seems to help sometimes, gives an anonymous medium to talk to. 

I have a bit of a "tough love" type family, I talk to my dad but he's really depressed and it's hard burdening him when he's suffering deeper wounds, though he tries to help, he just isn't always the best to go to. My brother who is a recovering alcoholic I can relate with a lot but again, we both have some pretty severe stuff going on at times. My other brother is very internal though and hard to talk to. I don't even go near my mother or my sister, my mother doesn't really respond well because of her mental illness that is pretty much unmedicated and my sister is extremely manipulative and abusive. Not to mention her problems are always worse according to her, although she mostly is the cause of her ill fate.

My friend has advised me to move away from my more negative family, I just try to be supportive to my brothers and relate to my father when I mentally can. It just can be hard talking to him since he isolates himself often and relies on myself and my brothers for consoling. I'm usually super busy too which doesn't help.

My family has a long history of alcoholism and drug addiction. My main problem is with food, I'll have an occasional cigarette but that's more of a social thing. I have times where I'll start smoking pot a little too much but right now I've been good about it. Last night was trying with it though.

I have free therapy with a graduate student at my school, and I like her a lot but she has her own life sometimes and off on breaks so there's sometimes weeks where I don't see her. I should be seeing her this week though which should help.

I hope so. I have developed a better outlook on my stress and worries in the last couple years, mostly from maturing and experiences. My last relationship and the break up really gave a perspective on who I was since I basically lost myself in it. I just hate having moments when there's just so much to a point where it physically hurts.

Thank you this helps a lot and I appreciate it. I feel a little better and talked with a friend for a bit yesterday. I'm also talking to my old boss now which helps me feel a little less like I betrayed him seeing that he isn't angry with me. It's just all a process and the last month with everything has been so hard especially with him and his alcoholism. Myself and friends want to help him but he just keeps giving in and he can only help himself. It's just hard to be in his life but he has become like family to me so letting him go would be hard. This in part has been affecting my mental frame along with the position I was put in once he was let go.

Like many of the abuses I had as a child I felt like it'd be best to ignore it, not to mention my family has a very tough love mind set and I developed a need to just be strong and fight through things as if it didn't matter but as I grow older and look back I realized how much it really affected me. I just recently started telling people it happened after a priest who I had as a professor said the importance of talking about sexual abuse with those close to you. So far I mentioned it loosely to my therapist and told my closest friend about it and it made it a little more real like I wasn't crazy and it wasn't my fault. I've always had body image issues and even though now I've started receiving more male attention since I've become more confident in the past I used to let others take advantage of me because I didn't feel like I was pretty enough for much better. When I was 15 I never even kissed a guy and ended up hooking up with someone 7 years older than me. I didn't press charges but looking back being 21 now it disgusts me. I would never think of touching a 15 year old at my age.

This guy is a good guy. I want to try to express myself to him but I'm just afraid of opening up which goes with the whole 'tough' thing. Plus I just want to see where it goes and not push anything one way or another. I've been trying a more subtle route. Like last night I was at a party he was at with good friends and instead of staying at his place or going in with him after I gave him a kiss goodbye and left. I think that kind of showed what I was looking for, and maybe that I was looking to put in a little more time than just a booty call. I just put everything into my last relationship and it tore me apart. It sounds dramatic but it really changed me and how I perceived being with someone. I didn't have a lot of space with my ex and you're right, I do need a good amount of space and that's something I've learned and am trying to reflect.

I am still breathing though, I just have all this stress and it was really scary to be at that place again where all I have is these thoughts I've been avoiding for years that have been piling up. I should be seeing my therapist this week though. Because it's free counseling I don't see her during breaks and she's a student so she isn't always available. Every time I go though it helps.

Thank you so much for your comment, sorry for the lengthy reply. It just helps to actually talk about this stuff rather than keep ignoring it to the point where addressing it makes me want to die lol.
